motivation: Audit remaining development errors and test domain/source weighting on the fixed nine-source fitting corpus. Previous tests are already observed and may only diagnose regressions.
encoder: reuse exact frozen encoder fitted only on the identical 616050 fitting rows; verify data/artifact hashes and real-score parity; do not fit any transformation on holdouts
feature_cache: fit and calibration retain original fitting representation; tune and threshold use the versioned inference sanitizer exactly as predict_bundle; hashes bind matrices, ordered source tables and encoder

weight_definitions.source_equal_domain_sqrt: inverse sqrt domain count, normalized to equal total weight per source

calibration: sigmoid C=1000/max_iter=200 on separate calibration only; source_equal weights equalize total mass per source without using labels; positive slope required; monotonic calibration alone is not evidence of better discrimination
control_calibration_variant: also test source_equal_sigmoid on the existing control classifier without refitting its encoder/classifier
policies: primary strict empirical 1% FPR per supported source; secondary pooled 1% FPR for descriptive tradeoffs only; choose all thresholds on threshold partition only

selection.inputs: tune only; compare against frozen previous research control, same development corpus
selection.detection_gate: macro source recall gain >=0.02; no supported-source recall loss >0.05; macro source Brier increase <=0.01
selection.calibration_gate: macro recall loss <=0.005; no supported-source recall loss >0.005; macro source Brier reduction >=0.005; no source Brier increase >0.02
selection.priority: eligible detection candidates first by macro recall, minimum source recall, then lower macro Brier; otherwise eligible calibration candidates by lower macro Brier then recall; otherwise retain control
selection.failed_gate_diagnostic: if control retained, freeze best new tune challenger by macro recall/minimum recall/lower macro Brier for failed-gate evaluation; never select from final tests

development_audit: source/structure confusion counts, within-representation publisher conflicts, calibration and deterministic development error review queues; no automatic relabeling; score-selected error queues are never final gold sampling frames
new_holdout: a separately pinned public publisher intake must be exposure-audited and frozen before candidate fitting; no URLs from that intake enter fitting/tuning/calibration/threshold. Global historical publisher labels never establish Indonesia gold or a contemporary temporal holdout
if_new_holdout_unavailable: require an explicit recorded source audit, report unavailable and do not claim an independent new test
limitations: no fabricated reviewers or Indonesia labels
domain separation does not establish independent campaigns
positive-only feeds cannot estimate FPR or traffic precision
noncommercial research restriction inherited from the foundation
